ana: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need owners, Jira links, and clear handoffs for the repeated KV cache eviction pattern. Short replies please.

raj: I can own the deep investigation + tenant heatmaps.

matt: I'll own the short-term threshold tweak and the canary rollout.

kim: I'll take dashboards and alerting, plus oncall runbook updates.

sophie: I'll own the regression tests in Optimize and add a probe for eviction bursts.

lena-pm: I'll be I for product and evaluate batch scheduling implications.

jira-bot: Created RW-3950: "Investigation: KV cache eviction spike" assigned to raj, due 2026-04-12. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3950

jira-bot: Created RW-3951: "Short-term eviction threshold tweak + canary" assigned to matt, due 2026-03-31. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3951

jira-bot: Created RW-3952: "Dashboards & alerts: per-tenant eviction metrics" assigned to kim, due 2026-03-31. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3952

jira-bot: Created RW-3953: "Optimize probe: eviction anomaly detector" assigned to sophie, due 2026-04-22. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3953

oncall-bot: Canary scheduled 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z for RW-3951; alert window 30m.

ana: (typo) ana: Please add acceptance criteria in each ticket. Example ACs: eviction_rate <= 2/min at 2x baseline, p95 latency delta < 5%, no increase in error rate.

raj: Adding ACs to RW-3950 and linking playbooks + tenant list.

matt: Will post canary runbook and results in this thread and update RW-3951. Canary command for reference:
```
kubectl -n inference patch cm cache-config --patch '{"data":{"eviction_threshold":"0.75"}}' && kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/cache-workers
```

lena-pm: I'll open a cross-team ticket for batch scheduling if traces show correlation with nightly jobs.

ana: Also request: tag these tickets with "recurring-incidents" and add a monthly review to the postmortem board. Sophie to own quarterly evals.

sophie: Will add the quarterly eval and configure the probe alerts.

ana: Great. Reconvene here after canary + initial investigation updates. Thanks everyone.
